videos.title: Carry on Again Christmas
videos.description: A silly retelling of Robert Louis Stevenson's classic story `Treasure Island'.

videos.title: Please, Sir!
videos.description: After a chance visit to the town of Reigate, Bernard dreams of married life in the idyllic countryside.

videos.title: Please, Sir!
videos.description: Maureen has dreams of becoming a nun, but is feeling increasingly disheartened by the reactions of others, including Mr Hedges.

videos.title: Please, Sir!
videos.description: Bernard is always honourable, even in the game of golf, his admirable behaviour may have, hopefully, rubbed off on his students.

videos.title: Minder on the Orient Express
videos.description: When a gangster passes away, he leaves his daughter with clues to the location of his ill-gotten gains. She offers Terry tickets to the Orient Express, and Terry and Arthur spot underworld business on the luxury train to Venice.

videos.title: Birds of a Feather
videos.description: Sharon and Tracey work out that Dorien is fast approaching an important birthday and decide that, whether she likes it or not, the event calls for a celebration.

videos.title: Birds of a Feather
videos.description: Sharon is back living in her council flat and Tracey is still in Chigwell with younger son Travis but what has become of Dorien? What can bring the sisters back together, and who else might return to the nest?

videos.title: Birds of a Feather
videos.description: Sharon finds that looking after Dorien's every wish is a full-time job and with money tight, Sharon and Tracey take Dorien's designer clothes to a car boot sale to raise funds.

videos.title: Birds of a Feather
videos.description: Money and space are still tight and Tracey cannot ignore the fact that Garth and Marcie are not getting any quality time together, so it has to be all change in the bedrooms again to give them some space.

videos.title: On the Buses
videos.description: There is a massive epidemic of the flu and many of the bus crews are down with it, which is good news for Stan and Jack as they are making a lot of money out of over-time.

videos.title: On the Buses
videos.description: The Annual Busmen's Ball comes round again, and the lads decide they want something a little more exciting this year. So, Jack arranges for a stripper.

videos.title: On the Buses
videos.description: Canteen lady Suzy takes pity on Stan and Jack and gives them food to take home. Her good deed is not appreciated, and she is fired. She is replaced by a new canteen attendant who has stricter rules.

videos.title: On the Buses
videos.description: When Blakey slips up on a chip on Stan's bus the company decrees that all staff should go on a First Aid course which they are obliged to pass. Stan has only twenty-four hours to swot up if he hopes to pass.

videos.title: On the Buses
videos.description: The toilet in the Butler household was installed by Stan's grandfather, and it is now time for a new one. However, Blakey has problems with how it travels to its new home.

videos.title: On the Buses
videos.description: A new batch of young girls training to be conductresses arrives, out of which Sally is the girl who turns all the men's heads. Jack and Stan seriously compete with each other for her attentions.

videos.title: On the Buses
videos.description: Stan samples the home-brewed beer which he has just made. It is very, very strong indeed, so much so that when he goes to work he is already tipsy and Blakey breathalyses him.

videos.title: On the Buses
videos.description: Olive wants to re-decorate her and Arthur's bedroom, so Stan gets two tins of paint from the depot. They are the bus colours, red and yellow, which Arthur mixes to make green. He omits to add hardeners so that the paint is very slow-drying.

videos.title: George and Mildred
videos.description: Mildred decides that she and her husband George will celebrate their wedding anniversary in style at a posh London hotel. However, chaos ensues when a shady businessman mistakes George for a hit man.

videos.title: Minder
videos.description: Arthur's old army mate Yorkie goes astray and mislays his trousers.

videos.title: Benidorm
videos.description: Joyce becomes convinced that new guest Mrs Simmonds is the hotel assessor, but her attempts to impress do not start smoothly when Mrs Simmonds witnesses Joyce evicting a furious Kenneth from his salon for late payment of rent. The hotel is also playing host to underworld figures Lennie and Neville, who gave Donald a hard time when he was in prison.

videos.title: Rising Damp
videos.description: Wedding bells are tolling in the boarding house, but do they toll for Rigsby?

videos.title: Rising Damp
videos.description: Rigsby has been busy trying to attract Miss Jones' attentions. Meanwhile, Miss Jones has been busy trying to attract Philip's attentions. During a chat with the boys, Rigsby is told that Philip has ten wives, and that he is seen as a God in his own country. Rigsby is somewhat sceptical and demands proof of Philip's powers. Philip claims he can make something appear, and so performs a small ritual.

videos.description: When George refuses to go with Mildred to a dance on board a boat in the Thames, she asks Robin to be her escort and he agrees. Mildred basks in the fact that her partner is much younger than the other males present.
